profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name appears in the workspace’s activity.
profile.name: Name

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Saved in your copy and applied on all your devices.

language.title: Language
language.description: The app speaks it on all your devices, and new boards get their default columns in it.

accessKey.title: Access key
accessKey.description: It’s what you use to sign in to this copy. Generating a new one signs out your other sessions. It doesn’t affect the vault’s master password.
accessKey.newDescription: The old key no longer works, and your other sessions have been signed out. It’s shown only once.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Agent tokens and projects belong to a specific workspace.
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.deleteDescription: Its projects, boards, documents, attachments and tokens will be deleted. This can’t be undone.

copy.title: This copy
copy.description: The version of Orqevio you’re running. Your copy checks for new versions at most every 12 hours.

how.button: Merge the Dependabot pull request in your copy’s repository, and it deploys itself. If you don’t see one, bump the create-orqevio version in its package.json.
how.source: In the repository, then restart the server:

version.kept: Your data, access key and vault are preserved.

erase.title: Erase this copy
erase.description: Permanently erases your workspaces, your vault and your tokens. The copy will ask for the setup code again.
erase.confirmDescription: This can’t be undone. Enter your access key to confirm.

uninstall.title: Uninstall Orqevio
uninstall.description: Deletes everything for good, attachments included, and leaves this copy unusable. Then it shows how to remove the copy itself from your Cloudflare account or your server.
uninstall.confirmDescription: This can’t be undone. You’ll lose:

loses.data: Your workspaces, projects, boards and documents.
loses.vault: Your vault. To keep it, export an encrypted copy from the vault first.
loses.agents: Your agents’ access and every session.

uninstall.afterwards: This is step 1 of 2. In step 2 you’ll see how to remove the copy itself from your Cloudflare account or your server.
uninstall.oneCommand: Installed it with the command? From your computer, {{command}} does both steps at once.
